that connect the different bones of the
skull. The skull is composed of multiple
bony plates for several reasons. They

animal grows, and the sutures give the
skull slight elasticity in case of trauma.
Animals with heavy antlers often have
complex suture joints for extra strength.

Mouse-deer escape predators by diving
into water and swimming underwater to
safety. Although unusual for deer, this
watery getaway may hint at evolutionary
history. In 2007, a fossil was discovered in
India of an extinct, small deer-like animal,
Indohyus, with bones adapted for life in the
water. Its aquatic adaptations suggest that
Indohyus could be an early ancestor of whales
and may be a "missing link" between whales
and land mammals.

how old the tree is, these rings form a record of the
past environment. They can be used to reconstruct
historical climactic conditions from a time before people
starting recording weather. Below is a section cut from
the trunk, but a thin core can be taken from a living tree to
see pattern of rings inside. In spring, when light and water are
abundant, the new cells that form are bigger, have thin cell walls,

The salmon migration, both as juvenile smolts migrating from natal
freshwater habitats to marine feeding grounds, and as adults returning
to spawning grounds, is among the most remarkable phenomena in
the natural world. Our lab has conducted extensive work to advance
the basic understanding of those migrations and the impact of a range

ocean currents, and river flows that often vary in both space and time.
Climate change has the potential to create new environmental conditions
for migratory salmon to experience. We use a variety of techniques and
tools to create links between the complex environments an individual fish
experiences and its behaviour and survival.
